turns.content: My friends went out last night and didn’t invite me.
I'm sorry to hear that. It can be tough to feel left out. Have you had a chance to talk to them about it? Sometimes, it helps to express how you feel.
I think they secretly don’t like me.

It’s understandable to feel that way, especially if you weren’t included. But sometimes, it might not be personal. Have you noticed any other signs that might support that feeling, or could it be a misunderstanding? Talking to them might help clarify things.
Honestly, I’m starting to think they’re fake friends.

That’s a tough realization. It’s important to surround yourself with people who genuinely care about you. Have you had any other experiences that made you feel this way? It might be worth reflecting on your friendships and considering what you want from them.
Maybe I should just stop talking to all of them.

That’s a valid feeling, especially if you’re feeling hurt. Before making any big decisions, it might help to take some time to think about what you really want. Sometimes, addressing the issue directly can lead to a better understanding. But if you feel like it’s best to distance yourself, that’s okay too. Your well-being is what matters most.
